name: extraktor
description: Read, verify, and compare public web sources with Extraktor.

interface.shortDescription: Read and compare public web sources.
interface.longDescription: Connect to Extraktor with OAuth. Read page text, retain source evidence, and compare facts from several pages.
defaultPrompt: Use $extraktor:read-source to read this page and check its claims against the source.
Use $extraktor:compare-sources to compare these pages and cite the evidence.
